data.animaCaption: Half-kneeling behind a supply crate as her charcoal trench coat parts over her leather thigh holster, she racks the slide of a silver pistol and shoots a sharp glance back to keep you in cover. Thin slits of blue streetlamp light slice across the dark safehouse blinds and glint off the steel barrel.
data.promptProse: Seen at an urgent tilted angle over the edge of a weathered wooden crate in a darkened safehouse, Ayachi Nene drops to one knee wearing a belted charcoal trench coat over a close-fitting burgundy turtleneck, short black skirt, black thighhighs, and a strapped leather thigh holster. Both hands work cleanly to rack the slide of a compact silver pistol while her coat falls open along her leg, her purple eyes flashing back over her shoulder with focused tension. Narrow slats of cold blue streetlamp light cut through the closed blinds, casting crisp stripes across her silver hair and the brushed metal of the slide.
data.story: 楼道里忽然传来陌生皮鞋的轻响。宁宁一把把你拉进木箱死角，半跪下来干脆利落地推弹上膛，炭灰风衣滑开露出一截皮质腿套，回头时气息还带着紧绷的微热——「别出声，数到三如果他们破门，你先从后窗走。」
